releaseNotes: The full-device tunnel carries traffic again, and split tunnelling works under it: rules that keep traffic out of the tunnel send it out the physical interface, a bypass rule naming a zone works on the first try, and "only selected" connects again. FakeDNS is scoped to the names a rule routes into the tunnel, IPv6 is no longer drawn into a tunnel it cannot leave, latency is measured through the tunnel, and profiles moved to the main screen.
